title: BreakThru!
overview:
Crush, keep crushing, and while crushing, you'll realize you're hooked. An original arrives in a new frontier of puzzle games: the "crushing game"!

BreakThru! puts a wall of colored bricks in front of you and gives you a time limit to tear it all down. Click any brick that touches at least one of the same color to smash the whole group, with bigger groups scoring more points. New bricks and items drop in from above, and you can steer them as they fall or slide the remaining wall left and right to make new matches. Bombs, rockets and super bricks help you blast through, while spiders get in the way. Clear the wall to move on to the next stage as you travel to cities around the world.

- Single, Cooperative, Competitive and Dual Wall modes
- Four difficulty levels
- One or two players, Shuttle Mouse compatible, memory backup saves

つぶす、つぶせば、つぶすとき、くせになってる自分に気付く。
